definition.setting: A workshop compares three packing methods A, B and C using three constructed times per method. Their means are 10−g, 10 and 10+g minutes. conditions: This is a bounded balanced construction with three groups of three outcomes, separation g from 0 to 4 minutes and within-group deviation w from 0.25 to 2 minutes. Times are constructed rather than measured or sampled. Between and within sums of squares have 2 and 6 degrees of freedom. The stated F(2,6) upper-tail probability additionally assumes independent normal errors with one common positive variance and the null of equal population means. Those conditions are declared, not tested. A small tail probability does not identify which means differ, show that every pair differs, estimate practical importance or establish causation. Extremely small nonzero separations that disappear in represented times receive a numerical precision state.

properties.claim: Separate the nine packing times into variation between three group means and variation within each group. Divide the two sums of squares by their degrees of freedom, then compare the mean squares with an F ratio.
properties.conditions: This is a bounded balanced construction with three groups of three outcomes, separation g from 0 to 4 minutes and within-group deviation w from 0.25 to 2 minutes. Times are constructed rather than measured or sampled. Between and within sums of squares have 2 and 6 degrees of freedom. The stated F(2,6) upper-tail probability additionally assumes independent normal errors with one common positive variance and the null of equal population means. properties.derivation: The grand mean of all nine constructed times is ten minutes. The group means lie at 10−g,10,10+g with three outcomes each, so between SS is 3(g²+0+g²)=6g². Each group contributes w²+0+w² within, giving 6w². Dividing by2 and6 produces F=3g²/w². The upper tail of an F distribution with2 and6 degrees of freedom is (1+F/3)^(−3). This is an omnibus mean comparison: its alternative allows at least one population mean to differ. The three constructed readings per method show where replication would supply within-group information in an actual experiment.
